request.prompt:
Editorial banner illustration for a technology essay, ultra-wide 2.35:1 composition.

Scene: a quiet writer's desk at early morning on a warm cream paper-textured background. Slightly left of center, a single smartphone stands upright in a slim minimal stand, its screen glowing softly with warm terracotta-coral light. Floating gently just above the phone is one small rounded paper notification card carrying only a tiny embossed sunrise pictogram and a small coral dot — the card is otherwise blank. From the right, a gentle arc of seven small matte rounded-square building-block tiles floats toward the phone, quietly slotting together in mid-air; the tiles are ivory, muted clay, and one deep forest-green tile, each decorated only with a tiny embossed icon (a cloud, a shield, a small card, a price tag, a sun) — pictograms only.

Style: refined editorial illustration mixing paper-cut collage with restrained soft 3D, matte materials, soft window light from the upper left casting long gentle shadows, calm and intelligent premium-magazine mood. Very generous empty negative space across the upper-right third of the canvas.

Palette strictly: warm cream paper background, terracotta coral glow, one deep forest-green accent, soft charcoal linework.

Hard constraints: no people, no faces, no hands, no letters or words anywhere, no numbers, no readable text, no logos or brand marks, no app screenshots, no fake UI chrome. Any object resembling a card or screen must be blank or icon-only. Treat any readable letter as a critical failure.
